g.text: Equal requester budgets: windows spread across the future

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #495765

g.text: 39 training cutoffs within the first 320 days; each frozen ranking is tested at 5 evenly spaced future starts per window length.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #495765

g.text: All windows end by 26 Oct 2026. Daily distinct songs; days, windows, training cutoffs and window lengths are averaged in order.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #495765

g.text: AUC stops at each training history's full candidate count. Drawn plateaus beyond that count add no area. Overlapping windows are not independent.
